response.answer: A workable option would be to participate only if the commitment can be shortened, seated, or otherwise adapted—and only after adequate recovery from the flood-monitoring watch. After an overnight watch, your attention can be unreliable, and prolonged standing aggravates your Achilles tendon. You also have a fixed Thursday 16:30 tendon-therapy assessment that cannot move because it is needed to clear you for next week’s river survey. Avoid relying on caffeine to push through; hydration and an early finish are your stated preference after a racing-heart episode.
